dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: Good morning. I'm Dr. Ahmed. How can I help you today?

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.text: Good morning, doctor. I've had a strong headache since yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: When exactly did the headache start?

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.text: It started last night, around 9 p.m.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: On a scale from 1 to 10, how strong is the pain?

key_phrases.phrase: How can I help you today?
key_phrases.meaning: A polite, open question to start a consultation.
examples: How can I help you today?
How can I help you this morning?

key_phrases.meaning: A question about the onset of a symptom.
A way to measure pain intensity.
examples: On a scale from 1 to 10, how strong is the pain?

multiple_choice.question: Which question is best to ask about onset?
Why do doctors use 'On a scale from 1 to 10'?
